notes.title: Chapter 9 and Chapter 10 updated
notes.content:
Hey Divers,We’ve been listening closely to your feedback, and we know a lot of you had frustrations with certain chapters. Today’s update is all about making your experience smoother, more engaging, and less repetitive. Here’s what’s changing:




           Chapter 9 – Streamlined Exploration

            Goal: Reduce unnecessary back-and-forth.

 Battery Requirement Reduced – You’ll now only need to place 2 batteries instead of 4 to progress.

 More Creature Encounters – Added additional creatures to keep the tension high.

 New Submarine Mechanic – In 2-Player Mode, the player in the sub can now fire missiles to blast through rock walls, opening up new paths.

 UI & Control Updates – The submarine HUD and controls have been reworked for clarity and smoother gameplay.


Chapter 10 – Quality of Life Upgrade

           Goal: Improve overall flow and reduce frustration.

Less Falling Debris – Rock and debris drops have been reduced by 40%, giving you more breathing room.

Missile Mechanic Added – Just like Chapter 9, the submarine can now blast rock walls to help you push forward.

UI & Control Updates – Same submarine updates carried over for consistency.


We Hear You
Your feedback continues to shape the game. These changes are just the start—keep sharing your thoughts with us, and we’ll keep improving Deepest Trench together.



Dive safe,
The Deepest Trench Team

notes.title: Demo Bug Fixes for October 3, 2024
notes.content:
User Interface Fixes 


 Increased “out of bounds” timer to give players more time to turn around. 
 Reduced tutorial text to better explain controls for character swaps. 
 Added an initial caption to remind players to consistently monitor oxygen levels.
 Added a tip to inform players on how to see current objectives.
 Added a tip to teach players about tools.
 Completed objectives now disappear off the mini-map.
 Task drawer time increased.
 Fixed “ascend” and “descend” controls layout for the submersible.


 

Gameplay Fixes 


 Fixed death animations when dying “out of bounds”.
 Fixed collider issue with a fuse and the wall. 
 Fixed pathing on the shark to give extra time. 
 Fixed collision/clip-through issue with the wall in Chapter 3.
 Heartbeat radius increased for megalodon when outside the facility. 


 

Hardware Fixes 


 For controllers, fixed a never-ending vibration after stage completion.
